explanation: Controller with max dt 0.02, light cart 0.5kg, initial offset x=0.5 v=0.5 theta=0.1 plus sensor noise 0.02 saturates at force_limit 40 but cannot stabilize; cart accelerates to v~11 m/s while pole angular velocity reaches -10.3 rad/s, pole angle diverges past 0.8 rad by step 11. Likely discrete-time state-feedback gains inadequate for coarse dt + noisy sensing + edge initial conditions, leading to instability and saturation.
